{"proof":"  have hS : S = ({(8 : ℝ), -14} : Finset ℝ) := by
    ext x
    rw [h₀ x]
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have hfactor : (x - 8) * (x + 14) = 0 := by
        nlinarith [hx]
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfactor with h | h
      · left
        linarith
      · right
        linarith
    · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> norm_num
  rw [hS]
  norm_num [Finset.sum_insert]"}
